descr: The offering generated about $93.5 billion in gross proceeds before fees, with $91.6 billion received by Anthropic.
paragrafi: The offering generated about $93.5 billion in gross proceeds before fees, with $91.6 billion received by Anthropic. Underwriters exercised their option to buy an additional 147,000,000 shares at the same price.
The shares began trading on Nasdaq under the ticker “ANT.”
Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley led the offering, with a consortium of banks serving as book‑running managers.
perche: The large capital raise gives Anthropic resources to expand its AI services and compete with other leading model providers. For users of free or locally run models, the influx of funding may intensify competition, potentially influencing the development of open‑source alternatives such as the top‑ranked Kimi K3 and GLM‑5.3 models.
